notes.title: Update 2024,12,17
notes.content:
●Fixed the problem that the next level could not be opened normally.
●Modify the problem of the game entering the level and the art gallery being fully opened
●Thank you for your suggestions. Since I have very little time to use it, I will repair it slowly.

. The next update will be based on everyone’s opinions and I will continue to revise and update within my capabilities.

We will try to update and add Spanish and French departments in the future.
